name: TogglyUpdateFeature
description: Update an existing feature flag in Toggly
helpMarkDown: Updates metadata for an existing feature flag. [Learn more](https://docs.toggly.io/integrations/azure-devops)
author: Toggly

inputs.name: featureKey
inputs.label: Feature Key
inputs.helpMarkDown: The key of the feature to update

inputs.name: featureName
inputs.label: Feature Name
inputs.helpMarkDown: New display name for the feature (leave empty to keep current)

inputs.name: description
inputs.label: Description
inputs.helpMarkDown: New description (leave empty to keep current)

inputs.name: category
inputs.label: Category
inputs.helpMarkDown: New category (leave empty to keep current)

inputs.name: tags
inputs.label: Tags
inputs.helpMarkDown: New comma-separated list of tags (leave empty to keep current)
